title: Witch Reading in Cosmic Library
description: A monochromatic illustration of a long-haired witch in flowing robes standing on a floating platform of books and candles while reading an open tome. The surreal scene is filled with levitating books, glowing candles, spiders, pentagrams, a stag skull, and swirling cosmic patterns in the background.
prompt: A solitary female witch with long flowing hair and ornate robes stands on a dark floating platform made of stacked books and numerous lit candles, deeply reading an open glowing tome. Surrounding her are levitating books, spiders, pentagram symbols, a stag skull atop a book tower, butterflies, and swirling cosmic nebulae with glowing orbs in a monochrome palette with subtle amber candlelight.
